entries.name: Dim Interior (No Source)
entries.positive: dark, dim lighting, shadow, indoors, soft shadow
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. Generic low light with no named light source; the negative keeps windows out. Remove 'window' from the negative if your location needs one.

entries.name: Moonlit (Outdoor)
entries.positive: night, moonlight, full moon, night sky, blue theme, dim lighting
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. Names the moon and sky on purpose, so it suits outdoor scenes.

entries.name: Moonlit (Interior, No Window)
entries.positive: dark, blue theme, cool colors, dim lighting, soft shadow, rim light
entries.negative: window, moon, night sky, daylight, sunlight
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. Gets the cool night mood without the words 'night' or 'moonlight', which tend to add a window.

entries.name: Warm Dim Glow (No Candles)
entries.positive: dim lighting, warm lighting, orange theme, soft glow, shadow, dark
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. Intimate warm low light with no named source, so candles and fires don't appear everywhere.

entries.name: Candlelit
entries.positive: candlelight, candle, warm lighting, dim lighting, orange theme, shadow
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. Candles will appear in the scene; use Warm Dim Glow if you don't want them.

entries.name: Fireplace Glow
entries.positive: fireplace, firelight, indoors, warm lighting, dim lighting, shadow
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. A fireplace will appear in the scene.

entries.name: Campfire Night
entries.positive: campfire, firelight, night, orange theme, dark, shadow, sparks
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. Outdoor scenes.

entries.name: Lamplight
entries.positive: lamp, warm lighting, dim lighting, shadow, indoors
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. A lamp will appear in the scene.

entries.name: Neon Night (City)
entries.positive: neon lights, night, glowing, colorful lighting, city lights
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. Add 'pink theme' or 'blue theme' to bias the color.

entries.name: Neon Interior (No Window)
entries.positive: neon lights, dark, indoors, colorful lighting, glowing, shadow
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. Neon mood for rooms and clubs without a city view.

entries.name: Dramatic Low-Key
entries.positive: dramatic lighting, high contrast, chiaroscuro, shadow, spotlight, dark
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. 'dramatic lighting' and 'chiaroscuro' are informal but widely respected by the model.

entries.name: Spotlight
entries.positive: spotlight, dark background, light beam, shadow, dark
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. Subject lit against darkness.

entries.name: Rim-Lit Shadows
entries.positive: rim light, backlighting, dark, shadow, dark background
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. Edge-lit subject with deep shadows.

entries.name: Silhouette
entries.negative: face focus, detailed face, front lighting
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. 'silhouette' is an exact Danbooru tag; add 'sunset' for an outdoor sky behind the figure.

entries.name: Under-Lighting (Horror)
entries.positive: dark, shadow, shaded face, dim lighting, from below, glowing
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. Moody, eerie look. 'shaded face' darkens the upper face.

entries.name: Cinematic Dark
entries.positive: cinematic lighting, volumetric lighting, light rays, dark, shadow
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. 'cinematic lighting' is not a strict Danbooru tag but works in practice.

entries.name: Magical Glow
entries.positive: glowing, light particles, bloom, sparkle, glowing eyes, dark background
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. Good for fantasy and magic effects.
